$script:ModuleAvailableCache = @{}
$script:CommandAvailableCache = @{}

* Overview

Fast, minimal, Catppuccin-themed PowerShell profile with optimized module loading,
PSReadLine configuration, custom functions, and CLI tool integration.

* Performance Optimizations

** Module Availability Caching

Cache module and command availability checks to reduce repeated startup overhead.
Scripts use these to lazy-load heavy modules only when needed.

#+begin_src powershell
function Test-Module {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name)
    if (-not $script:ModuleAvailableCache) { $script:ModuleAvailableCache = @{} }
    if ($script:ModuleAvailableCache.ContainsKey($Name)) { return $script:ModuleAvailableCache[$Name] }

    $exists = $null -ne (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name $Name)
    $script:ModuleAvailableCache[$Name] = $exists
    return $exists
}

function Test-Command {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name)
    if (-not $script:CommandAvailableCache) { $script:CommandAvailableCache = @{} }
    if ($script:CommandAvailableCache.ContainsKey($Name)) { return $script:CommandAvailableCache[$Name] }

    $exists = $null -ne (Get-Command $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    $script:CommandAvailableCache[$Name] = $exists
    return $exists
}

$isConsoleHost = $Host.Name -eq 'ConsoleHost'
$isInteractiveConsole = $isConsoleHost -and -not [Console]::IsOutputRedirected
$script:PoshGitLoaded = $false
$script:PSFzfLoaded = $false
#+end_src

* Environment

** HOME Directory

Windows does not set =HOME= by default; many tools (Git Bash, Emacs, =Join-Path $HOME= in
this profile) expect it. Use =USERPROFILE= so the profile works on any account name.

#+begin_src powershell
$env:HOME = $env:USERPROFILE

$configPathsLib = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.config\scripts\_lib\config-paths.ps1'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $configPathsLib) {
    . $configPathsLib
}
# Scripts are flat under ~/.config/scripts/ (not scripts/powershell/)
$script:ConfigScriptsRoot = Join-Path $HOME '.config\scripts'
#+end_src

* Terminal Colors

** $PSStyle.FileInfo Colors

PS 7.3+ colors directory names via $PSStyle.FileInfo. Stock settings often use a
blue background (reverse video) that clashes with dark themes (e.g. Catppuccin
in Windows Terminal). These are foreground-only 24-bit colors matching the
PSReadLine Catppuccin block.

#+begin_src powershell
if (Get-Variable PSStyle -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    if ($PSStyle.FileInfo) {
        $PSStyle.FileInfo.Directory    = "`e[38;2;137;180;250m"  # blue #89b4fa
        $PSStyle.FileInfo.SymbolicLink = "`e[38;2;203;166;247m"  # mauve #cba6f7
        $PSStyle.FileInfo.Executable   = "`e[38;2;166;227;161m"  # green #a6e3a1
    }
}

* PSReadLine Configuration

** Core Settings

Vi mode with cursor indicator, no duplicates in history, incremental save.
Bell disabled to reduce noise.

#+begin_src powershell
$psReadLineLoaded = $false
if (Test-Module PSReadLine) {
    Import-Module PSReadLine
    $psReadLineLoaded = $true

    Set-PSReadLineOption -EditMode Vi
    Set-PSReadLineOption -ViModeIndicator Cursor
    Set-PSReadLineOption -HistoryNoDuplicates
    Set-PSReadLineOption -HistorySaveStyle SaveIncrementally
    Set-PSReadLineOption -BellStyle None
#+end_src

** Predictions

Use Az.Tools.Predictor for enhanced suggestions if available, fallback to history.
Inline view keeps suggestions compact.

Defer Az.Tools.Predictor import using idle event to reduce startup time.

#+begin_src powershell
    if ($isInteractiveConsole) {
        # Defer Az.Tools.Predictor to reduce startup time
        # It will be imported on first prediction trigger
        Set-PSReadLineOption -PredictionSource History
        Set-PSReadLineOption -PredictionViewStyle InlineView

        # Async import of Az.Tools.Predictor after prompt appears
        $null = Register-EngineEvent -SourceIdentifier PowerShell.OnIdle -MaxTriggerCount 1 -Action {
            if (Test-Module Az.Tools.Predictor) {
                Import-Module Az.Tools.Predictor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                Set-PSReadLineOption -PredictionSource HistoryAndPlugin
            }
        }
    }
#+end_src

** PATH: Ollama CLI + himalaya + Doom Emacs

Add CLI tool bins to PATH so =ollama=, =himalaya=, and =doom= work in any terminal.
Emacs itself (=emacs=, =emacsclient=) is installed under Program Files; this adds
=~/.config/emacs/bin= (Doom CLI scripts: =doom=, =org-capture=, etc.).

#+begin_src powershell
$extraPaths = @(
    (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Ollama'),
    (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.config\himalaya\bin'),
    (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.config\emacs\bin')
)
# Session: prepend any that are missing so they work in THIS shell now. Compare
# against split entries (not -like "*$p*", which false-matches substrings).
foreach ($p in $extraPaths) {
    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) -and (($env:Path -split ';') -notcontains $p)) {
        $env:Path = "$p;$env:Path"
    }
}
# Persist for other apps — but add ONLY entries not already in the USER Path.
# The previous version appended all three on EVERY launch, which bloated the
# persisted Path to 221 entries (56 duplicate copies) and grew it past the length
# where spawned shells lose `node`. This is idempotent: no missing -> no write.
$have = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User') -split ';'
$missing = $extraPaths | Where-Object { $_ -and ($have -notcontains $_) }
if ($missing) {
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ((@($have | Where-Object { $_ }) + $missing) -join ';'), 'User')
}
#+end_src

* Prompt and Navigation

** Command Cache (Performance)

Batch command availability checks at startup to avoid multiple PATH searches.
To prevent massive lag, we ONLY check the core tools needed to construct the prompt and keybindings (starship, zoxide, eza, fzf, etc.). Other tools are checked on-demand via `Test-Command`.

#+begin_src powershell
$script:__cmdCache = $null
function Get-CommandCache {
    if ($null -eq $script:__cmdCache) {
        $script:__cmdCache = @{}
        $startupCmds = @('starship', 'zoxide', 'eza', 'bat', 'fzf', 'fd', 'es')
        foreach ($c in $startupCmds) {
            $script:__cmdCache[$c] = $null -ne (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
        }
    }
    return $script:__cmdCache
}

# Use cached checks for startup-critical commands
$__cmds = Get-CommandCache
#+end_src

** Zoxide

Initialize zoxide for smart directory jumping.
Guard prevents errors when zoxide is not installed.

#+begin_src powershell

    Invoke-Expression (& { (zoxide init powershell | Out-String) })
}

** Enhanced Z Function

Override z to support all zoxide flags/subcommands, not just navigation.
This function is always defined, but calls to =__zoxide_z= (the inner
navigation function that zoxide's init script creates) are reached only via
the default =else= branch. If zoxide is not installed, =zoxide init= is
skipped by the guard above and =__zoxide_z= is never defined; callers should
be aware that running =z <path>= on a system without zoxide will produce a
"command not found" error for =__zoxide_z=.

#+begin_src powershell
function z {
    if (-not $__cmds['zoxide']) {
        Write-Error "zoxide not installed. Install with: winget install ajeedqazi.zoxide"
        return
    }

    if ($args.Count -eq 0) {
        if (Get-Command __zoxide_z -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
            __zoxide_z ~
        } else {
            Write-Error "zoxide not initialized. Run: zoxide init powershell"
        }
        return
    }

    $first = $args[0]
    switch ($first) {
        { $_ -in @('add', 'remove', 'import', 'edit', 'init', 'query') } {
            & zoxide @args
            break
        }
        { $_ -in @('-l', '--list') } {
            & zoxide query -l @($args | Select-Object -Skip 1)
            break
        }
        { $_ -in @('-i', '--interactive') } {
            $result = & zoxide query -i @($args | Select-Object -Skip 1)
            if ($result) { Set-Location $result }
            break
        }
        { $_ -in @('-e', '--echo') } {
            & zoxide query @($args | Select-Object -Skip 1)
            break
        }
        default {
            if (Get-Command __zoxide_z -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
                __zoxide_z @args
            } else {
                Write-Error "zoxide not initialized. Run: zoxide init powershell"
            }
        }
    }
}
#+end_src

* Lazy Module Loaders

Ensure-PoshGit and Ensure-PSFzf trigger lazy imports to keep startup fast
while preserving features when needed.

#+begin_src powershell
function Ensure-PoshGit {
    if ($script:PoshGitLoaded) { return $true }
    if (-not $isInteractiveConsole -or -not (Test-Module posh-git)) { return $false }

    try {
        Import-Module posh-git -ErrorAction Stop
        $script:PoshGitLoaded = $true
        return $true
    } catch {
        Write-Warning "Failed to load posh-git: $_"
        return $false
    }
}

function Ensure-PSFzf {
    if ($script:PSFzfLoaded) { return $true }
    if (-not $isInteractiveConsole -or -not (Test-Module PSFzf) -or -not (Test-Command fzf) -or -not (Test-Command fd)) { return $false }

    try {
        Import-Module PSFzf -ErrorAction Stop
        $env:FZF_DEFAULT_COMMAND = "fd --type f --hidden --follow --exclude .git"
        $env:FZF_CTRL_T_COMMAND  = $env:FZF_DEFAULT_COMMAND
        $env:FZF_ALT_C_COMMAND   = "fd --type d --hidden --follow --exclude .git"
        Set-PsFzfOption -PSReadLineChordProvider 'Ctrl+/'
        $script:PSFzfLoaded = $true
        return $true
    } catch {
        Write-Warning "Failed to load PSFzf: $_"
        return $false
    }
}
#+end_src

* FZF Keybindings

Ctrl+Shift+r: Search history and inject selected line back into input (newest-first via --tac).
Ctrl+f: Find files with fd.
Ctrl+d: Find directories with fd.
Ctrl+j: Interactive zoxide navigation.

Uses cached command checks for startup performance. Ctrl+Shift+r uses stream-based
history reading with --tac (newest-first) for large history files.

#+begin_src powershell
if ($isInteractiveConsole -and $psReadLineLoaded -and $__cmds['fzf']) {
    Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler -Key Ctrl+Shift+r -ScriptBlock {
        $historyPath = (Get-PSReadLineOption).HistorySavePath
        $s = Get-Content -Path $historyPath -Tail 1000 | fzf --tac
        if ($s) { [Microsoft.PowerShell.PSConsoleReadLine]::Insert($s) }
    }

    if ($__cmds['fd']) {
        Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler -Key Ctrl+f -ScriptBlock {
            $f = fd | fzf
            if ($f) { [Microsoft.PowerShell.PSConsoleReadLine]::Insert($f) }
        }
        Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler -Key Ctrl+d -ScriptBlock {
            $d = fd --type d | fzf
            if ($d) { Set-Location $d }
        }
    }

    if ($__cmds['zoxide']) {
        Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler -Key Ctrl+j -ScriptBlock {
            $t = zoxide query -l | fzf
            if ($t) { Set-Location $t }
        }
    }
}
#+end_src

* ripgrep Search with Preview

fzf-rg searches with ripgrep and previews results with bat or Get-Content.

#+begin_src powershell
function fzf-rg {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0)]
        [string]$Pattern
    )

    try {
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Pattern)) {
            $Pattern = Read-Host "Search for"
            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Pattern)) {
                Write-Warning "Empty search pattern - aborting search"
                return
            }
        }

        if (-not (Ensure-PSFzf)) {
            Write-Error "Failed to load PSFzf module"
            return
        }

        if (-not (Test-Command rg)) {
            Write-Error "ripgrep (rg) not found. Install with: winget install BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC"
            return
        }

        if (-not (Test-Command fzf)) {
            Write-Error "fzf not found. Install with: winget install junegunn.fzf"
            return
        }

        $pathExpr = '$f=[regex]::Match($l,"^(?:[A-Za-z]:[\\/]|/)[^:]+").Value'
        $preview = if (Test-Command bat) {
            "powershell -NoProfile -Command `"\$l=\`"{1}\`";$pathExpr;bat --style=numbers --color=always \$f`""
        } else {
            "powershell -NoProfile -Command `"\$l=\`"{1}\`";$pathExpr;Get-Content \$f -TotalCount 200`""
        }

        $searchResult = rg --line-number --no-heading --color=always $Pattern 2>$null |
            fzf --ansi --preview $preview --preview-window "right:50%:wrap" 2>$null

        if ($searchResult -and $searchResult -match '^(?<path>(?:[A-Za-z]:[\\/]|/)[^:]+):(?<line>\d+):') {
            $filePath = $matches['path']
            $lineNumber = $matches['line']
            Write-Host "Selected: ${filePath}:$lineNumber" -ForegroundColor Green

            if (Test-Command code) {
                & code --goto "${filePath}:$lineNumber"
            } elseif (Test-Command emacsclient) {
                & emacsclient "+$lineNumber" "$filePath"
            }
        } elseif (-not $searchResult) {
            Write-Host "No selection made" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Search failed: $_"
    }
}
#+end_src

* Helper Functions

** File and Directory Operations

#+begin_src powershell
function ef {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Query,

        [int]$Count = 20,
        [string]$Path,
        [switch]$Folders,
        [switch]$FilesOnly
    )

    if (-not $__cmds['es']) {
        Write-Error "es not found. Install with: winget install voidtools.Everything.Cli"
        return
    }

    $search = ($Query -join ' ').Trim()
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($search)) {
        Write-Error "Usage: ef <search terms> [-Count N] [-Path <path>] [-Folders] [-FilesOnly]"
        return
    }

    $args = @('-n', $Count)
    if ($Path) { $args += @('-path', $Path) }
    if ($Folders) { $args += '/ad' }
    if ($FilesOnly) { $args += '/a-d' }
    $args += $search

    & es @args
}

function eff {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Query,

        [int]$Count = 20,
        [string]$Path
    )

    ef @Query -Count $Count -Path $Path -FilesOnly
}

function efd {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Query,

        [int]$Count = 20,
        [string]$Path
    )

    ef @Query -Count $Count -Path $Path -Folders
}

function eopen {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Query,

        [int]$Count = 20,
        [string]$Path,
        [switch]$Folders,
        [switch]$FilesOnly,
        [switch]$Select
    )

    if (-not $__cmds['es']) {
        Write-Error "es not found. Install with: winget install voidtools.Everything.Cli"
        return
    }

    $search = ($Query -join ' ').Trim()
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($search)) {
        Write-Error "Usage: eopen <search terms> [-Count N] [-Path <path>] [-Folders] [-FilesOnly] [-Select]"
        return
    }

    $args = @('-n', $Count)
    if ($Path) { $args += @('-path', $Path) }
    if ($Folders) { $args += '/ad' }
    if ($FilesOnly) { $args += '/a-d' }
    $args += $search

    $results = @(& es @args)
    if (-not $results) {
        Write-Warning "No Everything results found for '$search'"
        return
    }

    $target = if ($Select -and $__cmds['fzf'] -and $results.Count -gt 1) {
        $results | fzf --header="Select result to open"
    } else {
        $results[0]
    }

    if ($target) {
        Invoke-Item $target
    }
}

function ecd {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Query,

        [int]$Count = 20,
        [string]$Path,
        [switch]$Select
    )

    if (-not $__cmds['es']) {
        Write-Error "es not found. Install with: winget install voidtools.Everything.Cli"
        return
    }

    $search = ($Query -join ' ').Trim()
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($search)) {
        Write-Error "Usage: ecd <search terms> [-Count N] [-Path <path>] [-Select]"
        return
    }

    $args = @('-n', $Count)
    if ($Path) { $args += @('-path', $Path) }
    $args += '/ad'
    $args += $search

    $results = @(& es @args)
    if (-not $results) {
        Write-Warning "No matching directories found for '$search'"
        return
    }

    $target = if ($Select -and $__cmds['fzf'] -and $results.Count -gt 1) {
        $results | fzf --header="Select directory to enter"
    } else {
        $results[0]
    }

    if ($target) {
        Set-Location $target
        Write-Host "Changed to: $target" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
}

function mkcd {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0)]
        [ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()]
        [string]$Path
    )

    try {
        if (Test-Path $Path -PathType Container) {
            Set-Location -Path $Path -ErrorAction Stop
            Write-Host "Changed to existing directory: $Path" -ForegroundColor Green
            return
        }

        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
        Set-Location -Path $Path -ErrorAction Stop
        Write-Host "Created and entered directory: $Path" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to create or enter directory '$Path': $_"
    }
}

function take {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Paths
    )

    if ($Paths.Count -eq 1) {
        mkcd -Path $Paths[0]
    } else {
        Write-Error "take requires exactly one path argument"
    }
}

function extract {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0)]
        [ValidateScript({
            if (-not (Test-Path $_ -PathType Leaf)) {
                throw "File '$_' does not exist or is not a file"
            }
            return $true
        })]
        [string]$File
    )

    try {
        $fileInfo = Get-Item -Path $File -ErrorAction Stop

        switch -regex ($fileInfo.Name) {
            '\.zip$' {
                Expand-Archive -Path $File -DestinationPath $fileInfo.DirectoryName -ErrorAction Stop
                Write-Host "Extracted ZIP archive: $File" -ForegroundColor Green
            }
            '\.(tar\.gz|tgz)$' {
                tar -xzf $File -C $fileInfo.DirectoryName
                Write-Host "Extracted tar.gz archive: $File" -ForegroundColor Green
            }
            '\.(tar\.bz2|tbz2)$' {
                tar -xjf $File -C $fileInfo.DirectoryName
                Write-Host "Extracted tar.bz2 archive: $File" -ForegroundColor Green
            }
            '\.tar$' {
                tar -xf $File -C $fileInfo.DirectoryName
                Write-Host "Extracted tar archive: $File" -ForegroundColor Green
            }
            '\.7z$' {
                if (-not (Test-Command 7z)) {
                    Write-Error "7-Zip (7z) not found. Install with: winget install 7zip.7zip"
                    return
                }
                & 7z x $File -o"$($fileInfo.DirectoryName)" -y
                Write-Host "Extracted 7-Zip archive: $File" -ForegroundColor Green
            }
            default {
                Write-Error "Unsupported file type: $($fileInfo.Extension). Supported: .zip, .tar, .tar.gz, .tgz, .tar.bz2, .tbz2, .7z"
            }
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to extract '$File': $_"
    }
}

function reload { . $PROFILE }

function which {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Commands
    )

    if ($Commands.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Error "which requires at least one command name"
        return
    }

    try {
        $results = foreach ($cmd in $Commands) {
            $commandInfo = Get-Command -Name $cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if ($commandInfo) {
                [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Name = $commandInfo.Name
                    Source = $commandInfo.Source
                    CommandType = $commandInfo.CommandType
                }
            } else {
                [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Name = $cmd
                    Source = "Not found"
                    CommandType = "None"
                }
            }
        }

        $results | Format-Table -AutoSize
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to get command information: $_"
    }
}

function whereami {
    try {
        $location = Get-Location -ErrorAction Stop
        Write-Host $location.Path -ForegroundColor Cyan
        return $location.Path
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to get current location: $_"
    }
}

function touch {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Paths
    )

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        try {
            if (Test-Path $path) {
                (Get-Item $path).LastWriteTime = Get-Date
            } else {
                New-Item -ItemType File -Path $path -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
                Write-Host "Created file: $path" -ForegroundColor Green
            }
        } catch {
            Write-Error "Failed to touch '$path': $_"
        }
    }
}

function serve {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0)]
        [ValidateRange(1, 65535)]
        [int]$Port = 8000,

        [Parameter(Position=1)]
        [string]$Directory = (Get-Location).Path
    )

    try {
        if (-not (Test-Path $Directory -PathType Container)) {
            Write-Error "Directory '$Directory' does not exist"
            return
        }

        if (-not (Test-Command python)) {
            Write-Error "Python not found. Install Python to use the serve command"
            return
        }

        Write-Host "Starting HTTP server on port $Port serving directory: $Directory" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "Access at: http://localhost:$Port" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host "Press Ctrl+C to stop the server" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        Push-Location -Path $Directory
        try {
            python -m http.server $Port
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to start HTTP server: $_"
    }
}

function copypath {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position=0)]
        [string]$Path = (Get-Location).Path
    )

    try {
        if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
            Write-Error "Path '$Path' does not exist"
            return
        }

        $resolvedPath = Resolve-Path -Path $Path -ErrorAction Stop
        $resolvedPath.Path | Set-Clipboard -ErrorAction Stop
        Write-Host "Copied path: $($resolvedPath.Path)" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to copy path: $_"
    }
}
#+end_src

** Zoxide Directory Addition

Quickly add common directories to zoxide database.

#+begin_src powershell
function zoxide-add-home {
    param([string[]]$Dirs = @('.config', 'dev', 'Documents', 'Downloads'))
    if (-not $__cmds['zoxide']) {
        Write-Error "zoxide not installed. Install with: winget install ajeedqazi.zoxide"
        return
    }
    foreach ($d in $Dirs) {
        $base = Join-Path $HOME $d
        if (-not (Test-Path $base)) { continue }
        & zoxide add $base
        Get-ChildItem $base -Directory -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            ForEach-Object { & zoxide add $_.FullName }
    }
    Write-Host "Added $($Dirs -join ', ') to zoxide"
}

* Bookmarks

Simple directory bookmarking system. Marks are stored in ~/.marks.
Directory is created lazily on first use, not every startup.

#+begin_src powershell
# Lazy initialization for marks directory
function mark {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0)]
        [ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()]
        [string]$Name
    )

    try {
        $marksDir = Join-Path $HOME '.config\.marks'
        if (!(Test-Path $marksDir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $marksDir -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
        }

        $markFile = Join-Path $marksDir $Name
        $currentLocation = Get-Location -ErrorAction Stop
        Set-Content -Path $markFile -Value $currentLocation.Path -ErrorAction Stop
        Write-Host "Marked '$Name' -> $($currentLocation.Path)" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to create mark '$Name': $_"
    }
}

function jump {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0)]
        [ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()]
        [string]$Name
    )

    try {
        $marksDir = Join-Path $HOME '.config\.marks'
        $markFile = Join-Path $marksDir $Name

        if (!(Test-Path $markFile)) {
            Write-Error "Mark '$Name' not found. Use 'mark <name>' to create a mark first."
            return
        }

        $targetLocation = Get-Content -Path $markFile -ErrorAction Stop
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($targetLocation)) {
            Write-Error "Mark '$Name' is empty or corrupted."
            return
        }

        if (!(Test-Path $targetLocation)) {
            Write-Error "Mark '$Name' points to non-existent location: $targetLocation"
            return
        }

        Write-Host "Jumping '$Name' -> $targetLocation" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Set-Location -Path $targetLocation -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to jump to mark '$Name': $_"
    }
}
#+end_src

* Directory Stack Navigation

PowerShell pushd/popd with Alt+Arrow keybindings.
~back~ pops the location stack and saves the current dir to a forward stack.
~forward~ navigates to the top of the forward stack, pushing current dir back
onto the location stack so ~back~ can return to it again.

#+begin_src powershell
$global:__navForward = [System.Collections.Generic.Stack[string]]::new()

function back {
    try {
        $here = (Get-Location).Path
        Pop-Location
        $global:__navForward.Push($here)
    } catch { Write-Host 'No previous directory' -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
}

function forward {
    if ($global:__navForward.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host 'No forward directory' -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        return
    }
    Push-Location (Get-Location)
    Set-Location ($global:__navForward.Pop())
}

function stack   { Get-Location -Stack }

if ($isInteractiveConsole -and $psReadLineLoaded) {
    Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler -Key Alt+LeftArrow  -ScriptBlock { back }
    Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler -Key Alt+RightArrow -ScriptBlock { forward }
}
#+end_src

* Process Tools

Kill processes interactively with fzf, or directly by name.

- ~fkill~: Opens fzf to select a process from all running processes (sorted by CPU usage).
- ~fkill chrome~: Kills the first matching process by name immediately (no fzf prompt).

#+begin_src powershell
function fkill {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false, Position = 0)]
        [string]$ProcessName
    )

    if ($ProcessName) {
        $proc = Get-Process -Name $ProcessName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($proc) {
            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force
            Write-Host "Killed $($proc.ProcessName) (PID: $($proc.Id))" -ForegroundColor Green
        } else {
            Write-Host "No process matching '$ProcessName' found." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
        return
    }

    $null = Ensure-PSFzf
    if (-not (Test-Command fzf)) {
        Write-Host "fkill requires fzf (install with: winget install junegunn.fzf)" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }

    Get-Process |
        Sort-Object CPU -Descending |
        Select-Object Id, ProcessName, CPU, WorkingSet |
        fzf --header="Select process to kill" |
        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id ($_.Trim() -split '\s+')[0] -Force }
}
#+end_src

* Tangling

Shortcut for regenerating literate configs from PowerShell.

- =tangle all= runs the batch tangle script across =~/.config=
- =tangle powershell= tangles this file directly

Single-document targets can be passed as a full path, a path relative to
=~/.config=, or a bare file stem such as =kanata= when there is a unique match.

#+begin_src powershell
function Invoke-ConfigTangle {
    param(
        [Parameter(Position = 0)]
        [string]$Target,
        [switch]$DryRun
    )

    $configRoot = Join-Path $HOME '.config'
    $tangleScript = Join-Path $configRoot 'scripts\utility\tangle-configs.ps1'

    if (-not $Target) {
        Write-Host 'Usage: tangle all | tangle <stem> | tangle $env:USERPROFILE\.config\path\to\file.org' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        return
    }

    if ($Target -ieq 'all') {
        if (-not (Test-Path $tangleScript)) {
            Write-Host "Tangle script not found at $tangleScript" -ForegroundColor Red
            return
        }

        & $tangleScript -DryRun:$DryRun
        return
    }

    $targetNames = @($Target)
    if (-not [System.IO.Path]::HasExtension($Target)) {
        $targetNames += "$Target.org"
    }

    $candidatePaths = @()
    if (-not [System.IO.Path]::HasExtension($Target)) {
        $nestedStems = @{ scripts = 'scripts\scripts.org' }
        if ($nestedStems.ContainsKey($Target)) {
            $candidatePaths += (Join-Path $configRoot $nestedStems[$Target])
        }
    }
    foreach ($name in $targetNames) {
        $candidatePaths += $name
        $candidatePaths += (Join-Path $configRoot $name)
    }

    $orgFile = $candidatePaths |
        Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $orgFile) {
        $leafName = if ([System.IO.Path]::HasExtension($Target)) {
            [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($Target)
        } else {
            "$Target.org"
        }

        $escapedConfig  = [regex]::Escape($configRoot)
        $excludePattern = "$escapedConfig\\emacs\\|\\\.git\\|\\archive\\"
        $matches = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $configRoot -Filter $leafName -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch $excludePattern })

        if ($matches.Count -eq 1) {
            $orgFile = $matches[0].FullName
        } elseif ($matches.Count -gt 1) {
            Write-Host "Multiple matches found for '$Target':" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            $matches | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.FullName)" }
            Write-Host 'Use a more specific path.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
            return
        }
    }

    if (-not $orgFile) {
        Write-Host "No Org source found for '$Target' under $configRoot" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }

    if ([System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($orgFile) -ne '.org') {
        Write-Host "Target must resolve to an .org file: $orgFile" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }

    if (-not (Get-Command Get-EmacsExecutable -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        $pathsLib = Join-Path $configRoot 'scripts\_lib\config-paths.ps1'
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pathsLib) { . $pathsLib }
    }

    $emacsExe = Get-EmacsExecutable -Name emacs
    if (-not $emacsExe) {
        Write-Host 'Emacs not found. Install Emacs or ensure it is on PATH.' -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }

    $resolvedOrg = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $orgFile).Path
    $fwd = $resolvedOrg -replace '\\', '/'

    if ($DryRun) {
        Write-Host "Dry run — would tangle $resolvedOrg" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        return
    }

    Write-Host "Tangling $resolvedOrg..." -NoNewline

    $output = Invoke-EmacsOrgTangle -EmacsExe $emacsExe -OrgPath $resolvedOrg

    $tangleOk = $output -match 'Tangled \d+ code block'
    if ($tangleOk) {
        if ((Split-Path -Leaf $resolvedOrg) -eq 'kanata.org') {
            if (Get-Command Repair-KanataTangledFiles -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
                Repair-KanataTangledFiles -KanataDir (Join-Path $configRoot 'kanata')
            }
        }
        Write-Host ' OK' -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host " FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        $output | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" -ForegroundColor DarkRed }
    }
}

Set-Alias tangle Invoke-ConfigTangle
#+end_src

#+begin_src powershell
# Set by config-paths.ps1 when dot-sourced above; keep a fallback for partial loads.
if (-not $script:ConfigScriptsRoot) {
    $script:ConfigScriptsRoot = Join-Path $HOME '.config\scripts'
}

function Invoke-ConfigVerify {
    param(
        [string]$ConfigDir,
        [switch]$ReadOnly,
        [switch]$Fix
    )
    $verify = Join-Path $script:ConfigScriptsRoot 'utility\verify-org-tangle-sync.ps1'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $verify)) {
        Write-Host "Not found: $verify" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }
    if ($Fix) {
        if ($ConfigDir) { & $verify -ConfigDir $ConfigDir -ReadOnly:$false }
        else { & $verify -ReadOnly:$false }
    } elseif ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('ReadOnly')) {
        if ($ConfigDir) { & $verify -ConfigDir $ConfigDir -ReadOnly:$ReadOnly }
        else { & $verify -ReadOnly:$ReadOnly }
    } elseif ($ConfigDir) {
        & $verify -ConfigDir $ConfigDir
    } else {
        & $verify
    }
}

function Invoke-ConfigTangleValidate {
    param([switch]$DryRun)
    $batch = Join-Path $script:ConfigScriptsRoot 'utility\tangle-configs.ps1'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $batch)) {
        Write-Host "Not found: $batch" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }
    & $batch -DryRun:$DryRun -Validate:(-not $DryRun)
}

function Invoke-DeployStartupOrchestrator {
    $src = Join-Path $HOME '.config\scripts\startup\startup-orchestrator.vbs'
    $dst = Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp\startup-orchestrator.vbs'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src)) {
        Write-Host "Tangle scripts.org first — missing $src" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }
    try {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dst -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        Write-Host "Deployed: $dst" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Host 'Copy failed — run this function from an elevated PowerShell.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
    }
}

    )

function Invoke-PhonemeDev {
    param(
        [string]$Root,
        [switch]$KillStaleDaemon
    )
    $start = Join-Path $script:ConfigScriptsRoot 'phoneme\start-phoneme-dev.ps1'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $start)) {
        Write-Host "Not found: $start — run: tangle scripts" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }
    $args = @()
    if ($Root) { $args += '-Root', $Root }
    if ($KillStaleDaemon) { $args += '-KillStaleDaemon' }
    & $start @args
}

* Config Editor

Interactive config file picker. Opens selected config in Emacs (or Notepad as fallback).

- =profile=: Open fzf selector for all literate configs
- =profile powershell=: Open powershell.org directly
- =profile kanata=: Open kanata.org directly

#+begin_src powershell
function profile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
        [string]$Config = $null
    )

    $configs = @(
        @{ Name = "powershell"; Path = "powershell/powershell.org" },
        @{ Name = "git"; Path = "git/git.org" },
        @{ Name = "kanata"; Path = "kanata/kanata.org" },
        @{ Name = "komorebi"; Path = "komorebi/komorebi.org" },
        @{ Name = "starship"; Path = "starship/starship.org" },
        @{ Name = "espanso"; Path = "espanso/espanso.org" },
        @{ Name = "everything"; Path = "everything/everything.org" },
        @{ Name = "basic-memory"; Path = "basic-memory/basic-memory.org" },
        @{ Name = "scripts"; Path = "scripts/scripts.org" },
        @{ Name = "ttyd"; Path = "ttyd/ttyd.org" },
        @{ Name = "wtq"; Path = "wtq/wtq.org" },
        @{ Name = "vscode"; Path = "vscode/vscode.org" },
        @{ Name = "flowlauncher"; Path = "flowlauncher/flowlauncher.org" },
        @{ Name = "wezterm"; Path = "wezterm/wezterm.org" },
        @{ Name = "windows-terminal"; Path = "windows-terminal/windows-terminal.org" },
        @{ Name = "tridactyl"; Path = "tridactyl/tridactyl.org" }
    )

    if ($Config) {
        $selected = $configs | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*$Config*" } | Select-Object -First 1
    } else {
        $null = Ensure-PSFzf
        if (Test-Command fzf) {
            $selected = $configs | ForEach-Object { $_.Name } | fzf --header="Select config to edit"
            $selected = $configs | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $selected } | Select-Object -First 1
        } else {
            Write-Host "fzf not found. Available configs:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            $configs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.Name)" }
            return
        }
    }

    if ($selected) {
        $fullPath = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".config\$($selected.Path)"
        if (Test-Command emacs) {
            emacs $fullPath
        } else {
            notepad $fullPath
        }
    } else {
        Write-Host "Config not found." -ForegroundColor Red
    }
}
#+end_src

* Pan — GPU node (***-laptop)

=pan= opens the *Pan dashboard*: SSH into the GPU laptop's WSL over Tailscale and
launch its Hermes interactive TUI (which wears Pan's own skin — a green "🐐 Pan"
banner, visually distinct from Hermes). Pan is the second Hermes agent (son of Hermes).

- Windows host shell: =ssh ***@***.***.***.***=
- Pan / WSL (Linux + Hermes): port =2222=

#+begin_src powershell
function pan {
    # One hop via the always-on host sshd:22 that boots Pan's WSL AND launches the Hermes
    # dashboard (Pan skin). Works even if Pan was idle/off — no :2222, no timing gap.
    ssh -t -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new ***@***.***.***.*** "wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'hermes chat'"
}

function pan-sh {
    # SSH into Pan's WSL for a normal bash shell (no Hermes agent)
    ssh -t -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new ***@***.***.***.*** "wsl -d Ubuntu"
}
#+end_src
